system.description:
You conjure 4 reinforced spears of earth that all converge on a single creature you can see within range from 4 different points surround the target creature. Make a Ninjutsu Attack on the target creature dealing 5d12 Earth damage as they attempt to skewer the target. A 20-foot cube centering on the target creature becomes difficult terrain and creatures cannot take the dash, dodge or disengage actions while within an area of difficult terrain created by this jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
